content:
Day 1 Thou dost arrive in Tokyo Japan  
Thou dost wander the neon lanes of Shibuya and pay homage to the faithful Hachiko  
As night falls thou dost partake in a serene tea ceremony beneath cherry blossoms  

Day 2 Thou dost journey to the historic Meiji Shrine  
Thou dost stroll through the tranquil Yoyogi Park and admire the towering torii  
Afternoon thou dost explore the eclectic shops of Harajuku and taste sweet crepes  
Evening thou dost ascend the Tokyo Tower to behold the cityscape aglow  

Day 3 Thou dost take the shinkansen to Kyoto Japan  
Thou dost check into a ryokan and feel the warmth of tatami mats  
Thou dost visit the golden Kinkakuji temple and reflect upon its shimmering pond  

Day 4 Thou dost wander the Arashiyama Bamboo Grove  
Thou dost cross the Togetsukyo Bridge and hear the whisper of the wind  
Thou dost visit the Tenryuji Temple and meditate in its Zen garden  

Day 5 Thou dost explore the historic Gion district  
Thou dost hope to glimpse a geisha gliding along the stone streets  
Thou dost partake in a kaiseki dinner of seasonal delicacies  

Day 6 Thou dost travel to Nara Japan  
Thou dost greet the friendly deer that roam Nara Park  
Thou dost admire the great Todaiji Temple housing the colossal Buddha  

Day 7 Thou dost return to Tokyo Japan  
Thou dost spend thy final hours in the vibrant Akihabara district  
Thou dost seek out anime treasures and electronic wonders  
Thou dost bid farewell to the Land of the Rising Sun with a heart full of memories
